postings.title: Tech Lead - Core Infrastructure
postings.description:
ABOUT BUILD

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world’s most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.



Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI.



We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.



To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We’re backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world’s best venture capital firms.



Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You own the foundational systems that make Build’s agentic AI real in production. This role is responsible for the infrastructure that orchestrates autonomous agents, manages long-running, high-stakes workflows, and guarantees reliability at institutional scale. Your work sets the hard limits of speed, autonomy, and trust across the entire product;

 - Build and operate the core primitives: agent orchestration, workflow engines, state management, eventing, and execution reliability.

 - Design systems that survive real-world failure modes: partial data, human handoffs, long timelines, regulatory constraints, and zero tolerance for silent errors.

 - Make architectural decisions that directly determine product capability, velocity, and customer trust.

 - Own infrastructure end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and ongoing evolution.

 - Work tightly with product, applied AI, and domain experts to translate abstract workflows into durable, production-grade systems.

 - Set the technical bar for robustness and clarity; other engineers build on what you create.



Security and compliance responsibilities

This role carries direct responsibility for the security posture of Build's production infrastructure. In practice, that means:

• Owning security oversight across the infrastructure layer, including risk assessments, tooling, and incident response readiness.
• Ensuring systems meet and maintain compliance requirements - including SOC 2 and, where applicable, PCI DSS - and that evidence is collected, documented, and audit-ready.
• Maintaining up-to-date documentation of security-relevant responsibilities across the engineering team, stored in a shared repository and updated as roles evolve.
• Acting as the primary point of contact for infrastructure security during audits, customer due diligence, and compliance reviews.
• Collaborating with any privacy or data protection function to ensure PII handling, data residency, and regulatory obligations are reflected in system design from day one.




HOW TO WIN AT BUILD

Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we’re focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us.



Performance and teamwork are the core of Build’s operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for;

 - Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.

 - Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.

 - Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that’s where most of the returns are realized.

 - Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You’re meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.

 - Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.

 - Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn’t easy.

 - Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it’s the only way to do truly extraordinary things.

 - Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you’re always looking for routes to do more with less.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end-to-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity.

 - An accelerated founder’s track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company – Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability – there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.

 - Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates.

 - Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture - from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional.

 - Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn’t live in the abstract - it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate directly into the world around us.

postings.title: Commercial Lead
postings.description:
ABOUT BUILD

AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world’s most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.

Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI. We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.

To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We’re backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world’s best venture capital firms.

Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.




THE ROLE

Build is at the moment where commercial velocity becomes the constraint. The product is working. The team is growing. The pipeline is strong. What we need now is someone who can take a high volume of inbound and outbound interest and convert it predictably, and build the systems that make that conversion repeatable.

"The close motion is working. Your job is to make it clockwork."

This is not a traditional sales role. You will be working with CIOs, heads of acquisitions, and development directors at some of the world's largest real estate institutions. You need to understand their world, speak their language, and make the case for Build in terms that resonate with people who have seen every vendor pitch imaginable.

Build has an insanely strong inbound motion through word of mouth and your job is to evolve the playbook so closing becomes clockwork. You will work directly with the founders, own the commercial motion end-to-end, bring in the right technical/domain team member to service the deal and build the function that drives Build's growth. 



Rather than a team of AEs, you'll be driving great commercial practice through our domain team who act as technical credibility and delivery once contracts are signed. This means that in time, the role is more geared towards enablement and system building with heavy business development.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the full commercial motion: qualification, pipeline management, proposal, close

 - Run outbound campaigns targeting institutional real estate investors, developers, and operators

 - Manage and grow a pipeline of enterprise and institutional accounts

 - Develop and iterate the GTM playbook: what works, what doesn't, what scales

 - Coordinate with the domain and delivery team to scope engagements and set expectations accurately

 - Build the systems and processes that make closing repeatable and predictable

 - Represent Build in senior commercial conversations. You are credible in the room




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A degree in civil, structural, or technical engineering, and/or a track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in institutional real estate, infrastructure, or adjacent professional services

 - Comfort with long sales cycles and the patience to move them without losing momentum

 - Strong enough domain knowledge to hold a conversation with a head of acquisitions without needing to look anything up

 - Genuine, proven curiosity about AI and what it can do for the built world, not just a talking point

 - Automation-first mindset: your first instinct when a process is repetitive is to automate it, not hire for it

 - Builder instinct: you don't wait for a process to exist, you improve it

 - Clear, direct communication, written and verbal

 - Based in New York or willing to be

 - Willing to get on a plane and do what it takes to drive deals to close




WHAT THIS IS NOT

 - A volume SDR motion. We don't win deals by sending 500 cold emails.

 - A product demo role. You need to understand what Build does well enough to have the conversation without a deck.

 - A pre-sales and post-sales split. At Build there is no handoff. You loop in the most qualified domain expert to drive the technical side of the conversation, in the room, for as long as it takes to close.

 - A role for someone who needs a playbook handed to them. One exists. Your job is to evolve it through direct market exposure.

postings.title: Expert - Grid & Energy Systems
postings.description:
ABOUT BUILD

Build is creating the agentic AI stack for the built world. We help institutional real estate teams automate complex development and acquisitions workflows so important projects can move from concept to completion faster, with less cost, delay, and operational drag.

Our customers include some of the largest built-world institutions: alternative asset investors, developers, infrastructure owners, energy companies, industrial operators, and public-sector partners. Their work shapes the physical world, but the workflows behind that work are still slow, fragmented, document-heavy, and dependent on expert coordination.

We believe the next generation of built-world software will not just organize work. It will help do the work. Agents will reason across documents, drawings, financial models, market data, approvals, constraints, and expert judgment. Human experts will stay in control, but they will operate with far more leverage.

We are backed by leading investors and operators, including executives from Blackstone and OpenAI, alongside top venture firms. We are building a generational company at the intersection of AI and the physical world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The data center build-out is the defining infrastructure challenge of this decade. Every hyperscaler, every operator, every institutional developer is constrained by one thing above all others: power. Getting it, connecting it, planning around it, and moving fast enough to matter.

Build pairs agentic AI with deep domain expertise to deliver the work that used to take weeks in hours. We work with some of the largest infrastructure investors, developers, and operators in the world. Our domain experts are the reason the outputs are trusted.

"The AI does the work. The domain expert makes it right."

This role is for someone who has spent years inside the grid — not studying it, operating it. Transmission planning, real-time dispatch, SCADA, contingency analysis, power flow studies. You understand why decisions get made the way they do, and you can explain it clearly to people who are moving fast and need to get it right.

You'll review, validate, and steer AI-generated work across live client engagements. You'll help define what good judgment looks like in practice. And you'll be part of a small, high-output team doing work that actually moves the needle on how the world's most important infrastructure gets built.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review and validate AI-generated energy systems work — contingency assessments, power flow studies, interconnection analysis, capacity planning

 - Apply practitioner judgment to real client problems: what's physically feasible, what the trade-offs are, and where the AI got it wrong

 - Collaborate with Build's engineering and domain teams to improve workflow accuracy and output quality over time

 - Produce operational analyses, planning scenarios, and written assessments where needed

 - Help articulate what "correct" looks like — the assumptions, constraints, and engineering realities that aren't in any textbook




DOMAIN FOCUS

Build's grid and energy engagements span the full stack of what institutional infrastructure clients need:

 - Grid planning and optimization — OPF, N-1/N-2 contingency screening, load flow studies, renewable integration

 - Power availability and interconnection — site-level power assessment, grid connection feasibility, capacity analysis

 - Data and process workflows — historian data, compliance documentation, audit trail interpretation

 - Regulatory and standards environments — NERC CIP, TSO/ISO operating frameworks, utility compliance

Tools our clients and workflows operate around include PSS/E, PowerWorld, MATPOWER, and OpenDSS. You don't need to know all of them — but you should be comfortable with the environments they represent.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in transmission planning, power systems engineering, or utility systems — at a TSO, ISO, or large utility

 - The ability to explain why a decision is correct, not just produce it — trade-offs, constraints, physical limits

 - Clear, direct written communication. Our workflows are asynchronous and our clients move fast.

 - Comfort working with AI-generated outputs and improving them — not just reviewing from a distance

 - Preference for flexible, contract-based engagements over traditional employment




HOW IT WORKS

 - Fully remote, contract-based

 - Engagements vary in scope and duration — some short-term, some ongoing retainers

 - Hourly rate: $75–$200 depending on experience and scope. Exceptional expertise goes higher.

 - Ongoing collaborations structured as monthly retainers where volume justifies it

 - Assessment: CV review and a paid work sample if there's a fit

postings.title: Product - Neofirm
postings.description:
THE ROLE

At Build, the company is the product. Every client interaction, every output, every workflow is an expression of what we believe software and expert services can become when you collapse the boundary between them. This role sits at the centre of that.

We're looking for someone who thinks about product beyond traditional definitions. Someone who can navigate design, engineering, architecture and systems with ease. The ideal fit for this role is an extremely talented IC who sees themselves as a future CPO or CPTO with high executive function.

"Product at Build isn't a function. It's the firm itself."

Sitting at the center of the company with the CEO, you will own everything that touches the customer - the interface between Build's AI capabilities and the people and institutions we work with. That means the brand we are developing, the services we develop, the interfaces we ship, the way outputs are delivered, the experience of being a Build client from first contact to deep deployment.

You'll also work directly the engineering and domain teams. There's no layer between you and the thing being built.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Take Build's brand foundations and amplify them to world class

 - Define and own the product implementation for Build's client-facing surfaces - from workflow design to output delivery to the Workflow Builder platform

 - Translate complex agentic AI capabilities into interfaces and experiences that are used internally through to the world's largest institutions

 - Work end-to-end: identify what needs to exist, design how it should work, and build or direct the engineering to make it real

 - Partner with domain leads to turn expert knowledge into repeatable, scalable workflows - from development, to acquisitions and financing, to design

 - Own the quality bar for everything a client sees, touches, or receives

 - Be the voice of the user inside the engineering team and the voice of the engineer inside client conversations

 - Identify the gaps between what we do and what clients believe we do - and close them




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proficiency in design and engineering - you can prototype fast and write a pull request.

 - Strong spatial and systems thinking. You see how the pieces relate before anyone asks you to

 - Experience building products that non-technical users rely on for high-stakes decisions

 - Comfort with ambiguity - this role doesn't have a clear playbook yet, and that's the point

 - Strong communication skills. You can achieve great things because your bar is so high and you have the charm to convince people to reach it

 - You operate for growth. You design, engineer, convince and cajole around growth because achieving scale is the only way you can make your dreams come true




BACKGROUND

There's no single profile we're hiring from. The person we want might come from:

 - Architecture or the built environment - you understand what our clients do and why the problem Build is solving is hard

 - Enterprise services or technical consulting - you understand what it takes to create a generationally impactful services firm because you worked in one

 - A founding role or previous founder - you've had to be the designer, the PM, and the engineer because there was nobody else

What matters more than background is attitude. If you know you a world class product person and need an opportunity that brings that to light, Build could be for you.

The scope of this role is precise and the bar is extraordinarily high. We fully expect there are only a handful of people in the world who can meet it.

If that's you, apply. If you want to be instantly shortlisted: find the CEO's email and complete the following.

Technical challenge:



A sovereign wealth fund is developing a 100MW data centre campus on a brownfield site in Brittany, France - 48.060095, −1.706889. They have four weeks to convince the local community that their project is going to be extraordinary. They're bringing their own power.

Design the process. Design what the community sees. Design what the project becomes. From strategy to planning to output. Any format. As long or short as you'd like.

postings.title: Former Founder - Craft Your Own Role
postings.description:
ABOUT BUILD

Build is creating the agentic AI stack for the built world. We help institutional real estate teams automate complex development and acquisitions workflows so important projects move from concept to completion faster, with less cost, delay, and operational drag.

Our customers include some of the largest institutions in the world: alternative asset investors, hyperscale developers, infrastructure owners, energy companies, and public-sector partners. We are backed by Tier 1 VC and angels/C-suite from from Palantir, OpenAI, Blackstone, and Google DeepMind.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are not looking for someone to fill a seat. We are looking for someone who sees what Build is building, knows where they fit, and wants to come in and make that contribution real.

"If you have to ask what the role is, it probably isn't for you. If you already know, come and talk to us."

Build is at a stage where the right person can define a function, own a relationship, or unlock a capability that we haven't fully articulated yet. If you've built something before, you know what that moment looks like and what it requires.

We are particularly interested in people who have operated at the intersection of AI, real estate, infrastructure, or complex enterprise services. But we will not rule out anyone who makes a compelling case for why they belong here.




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Founded or co-founded something that had traction

 - Have an extremely unconventional background that led you to startups

 - Are technical enough to work directly with AI systems and evaluate what good looks like

 - Thrive when the playbook doesn't exist and you have to write it

 - Move fast, communicate clearly, and don't need to be told what to do next

 - Are genuinely curious about the built world, not just AI in the abstract

 - Have strong opinions about quality and won't let things ship below the bar

 - Have a love for the built world that goes far beyond Build as a company




YOU WILL NOT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Need a defined role, clear reporting lines, and a predictable roadmap

 - Want to advise rather than execute

 - Are not comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and owning the outcome

 - Think the built world is just a market vertical, not one of the most important problems of the next decade

postings.title: Domain Expert
postings.description:
What we do

Build is an AI company for the built world. We pair agentic AI with domain experts to accelerate the most important pre-development work behind the world's largest built projects - site selection, due diligence, feasibility, planning, and design. Our clients include some of the largest data centre developers, institutional real estate firms, and hyperscalers in the world.

What this role is

We are looking for people who are deeply expert in a specific part of the Built World.

This is not a generic consulting role. It is a role for people who have spent years inside the industry and are frustrated by how slowly and expensively things get done. People who can look at their own work and say: this is what takes the most time, this is why it takes that long, and this is what it would look like if it moved ten times faster.

You will work alongside Build's AI systems to deliver outcomes for clients - and in doing so, you will help us build the systems that eventually run themselves.

What we are looking for

The first thing we ask every candidate to do is submit a proposal for a workflow.


Specifically: describe one workflow from your current or previous role that you believe could be automated or dramatically accelerated with the right AI system. Include what the workflow is, why it takes as long as it does, what a good outcome looks like, and how you would know if the automation was working.

If your proposal is compelling, we will reach out.

Who this might be

• A data centre developer who has spent years navigating grid connection queues
• A planning consultant who knows where every application gets stuck
• A real estate analyst who screens acquisitions across multiple markets
• An infrastructure advisor who has run the same due diligence process dozens of times
• A design professional who can translate a brief into buildable massing in their sleep

We work across digital infrastructure, industrial, energy, and institutional real estate. If your expertise sits somewhere in that world and you have something to say about what should be automated, we want to hear from you.

To apply

Submit your workflow proposal to james at build dot inc alongside an application here.

postings.title: Business Development Manager
postings.description:
About Build


Build is a neofirm for the built world. We help the world's biggest institutions build faster by delivering work in a fraction of the time, at software margins. We have delivered over 400 projects across 20 countries for hyperscale operators, Fortune 500 companies, neoclouds, governments, and the world's largest institutional developers.

The pipeline is real. The product is working. We need someone to go find the next wave of customers and convert the waves of commercial partners that our already driving our pipeline.

This is a sales role. You will own new business from first contact to signed contract. You will work the referral network, follow the capital flows, and get in front of the people who are moving the most ambitious built projects in the world. Build is growing fast and inbound interest is scaling with it. You will be responsible for converting that inbound with the same urgency and discipline you bring to outbound.

What you will own

• Sourcing and closing new customers across digital infrastructure, industrial, and energy real estate
• Converting inbound leads quickly and effectively as Build's market presence scales
• Building and working a pipeline of developers, operators, institutional investors, and hyperscalers
• Running the full sales motion: outbound, qualification, discovery, proposal, close
• Working with the delivery team to scope engagements and set customers up for success from day one
• Feeding market intelligence back into the product and commercial teams: what are buyers asking for, what objections come up, what is the competition doing
• Representing Build at industry events, conferences, and in the rooms where deals get made

Who we are looking for

You have 3-6 years of commercial experience in real estate (data centers or brokerage preferred), infrastructure, or a related industry. You have sold something: a service, a platform, a mandate, to institutional buyers and you know how those conversations work. You understand how capital moves through the built world and you can talk credibly to a development director, a head of acquisitions, or a CIO.

You are comfortable running an outbound motion without a playbook. You are disciplined enough to manage a pipeline without being managed. You find the right people, get in front of them, and close.

postings.title: Head of Ops
postings.description:
Head of Operations

Build is a neofirm for the built world. We help the world's biggest institutions build faster by delivering work in a fraction of the time, at software margins. In the past year, we have driven over 400 projects across 20 countries for hyperscale operators, Fortune 500 companies, neoclouds, governments, and the world's largest institutional developers.

Build is at the point where the internal machine needs to run without the CEO managing it. The product is working. The pipeline is real. The team is growing. What we need now is someone who can own the operational core of the company so that the founders can be fully external.

This is not a support role. You will own the number - cash, burn, runway - and make sure the company is structured to scale. You will be the person who knows where everything stands before anyone asks.

At Build, the operation is a product. Every process you design should be asking the same question: can this be automated? The company runs on the same agentic infrastructure we sell to customers. Internal operations is a product problem, not a headcount problem. That means you are not just running the back office — you are making strategic calls over the right numbers, building systems that compound, and treating efficiency as a competitive advantage.

What you will own

• The P&L: cash position, burn rate, monthly close, and the financial discipline that keeps the company in a position of strength
• Strategic financial decisions: when to hire, when to invest, when to hold - driven by the right metrics, not gut feel
• Talent operations: recruiting infrastructure, offers, onboarding, and the systems that let us hire fast without dropping standards
• Internal resourcing: making sure the delivery team has what they need to do the work - tools, data, vendor relationships, operational support
• Company cadence: the weekly rhythm, the rituals, the reporting that keeps everyone aligned without meetings that should not exist
• Legal and compliance: not doing the work, but making sure it gets done. Contracts, entity management, regulatory requirements.
• Turn ad hoc operational work into repeatable systems: if you are doing the same thing twice, you are building the wrong thing
• The things that fall through the cracks: if it matters and nobody owns it, you own it

Who we are looking for

You have built or scaled something before, as a founder, as a first operator at a startup, or as the person who made a team of 10 work like a team of 50. You come from real estate, infrastructure, or an adjacent industry. You understand how institutions buy, how development deals get done, and why the built world moves the way it does.

You are comfortable with financials and use (and build) data to make heavy operational decisions with confidence. You see operations as a strategic lever, not an administrative function. You are a systems thinker who gets satisfaction from things running cleanly. You do not need to be told what the problems are. You find them.
